sources.title: muxy-app/muxy repository
sources.finding: Main repository: 2,390 stars on 2026-11-16, Apache-2.0 per GitHub, default branch main, not archived.

sources.title: Muxy README
sources.finding: Lightweight terminal multiplexer built with Rust, GPUI and libghostty; background and remote sessions, worktrees, extensions, iOS and Android companion apps, AI agent integrations; macOS 14+, experimental Ubuntu Linux; Apache-2.0.

sources.title: Apache License 2.0 file
sources.finding: Repository license is Apache-2.0; earlier MIT contributions are noted in NOTICE.

sources.title: Getting started
sources.finding: Desktop app on macOS 14+ (Apple Silicon, Intel) and experimental Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 and ARM64; muxy CLI and server on macOS and Linux (glibc 2.35+).

sources.title: AI agents
sources.locator: Supported agents, States, Notifications, Agents panel, Saved agent sessions
sources.finding: Recognizes Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Droid, Grok, Hermes, Kiro, Oh My Pi, OpenCode, Pi and Xal in terminals with working, waiting and idle states; best effort; macOS and phone push notifications; saved-session discovery and resume for seven providers.

sources.title: Server
sources.finding: muxy-server runs every terminal; sessions survive app quit, crash and sleep; stopping the server ends terminals but saved screens and history remain; ended sessions pruned after 7 days; several apps can type into one session.

sources.title: Mobile
sources.locator: Pair a phone, Push notifications, What a phone can do
sources.finding: Phones pair over TLS or connect over SSH; full terminal, project, Git and file access except server and client management and exec; push through a relay that cannot read content.

sources.title: Mobile technical notes
sources.finding: Phone apps are Swift or Kotlin shells over the muxy-mobile Rust client library.

sources.title: Remote servers
sources.finding: Projects on other computers over SSH or pairing; each computer runs its own muxy-server so remote terminals keep running; app can install Muxy there; loginctl linger advice.

sources.title: Muxy CLI
sources.finding: CLI for server, project, session (create, send, send-keys, read-screen, wait, end), worktree (create, checkout-pr), activity, browser, extension, status and exec with --json output and --host for remote.

sources.title: Projects and worktrees
sources.finding: Git worktrees as projects with their own tabs; setup and teardown commands from .muxy/worktree.json run only when enabled.

sources.title: Git
sources.locator: Commit, Create a pull request, AI tools
sources.finding: Commit and Create PR use an installed AI CLI to write messages; PR status, merge (merge, squash, rebase), update and close via gh; PR features need gh signed in.

sources.title: Composer
sources.finding: Composer sends long prompts, files and images to the active terminal or every visible terminal.

sources.title: Extensions overview
sources.finding: Web-based extensions add tabs, panels, status items and background logic; extension APIs run through the desktop app.

sources.title: Extension permissions
sources.finding: Extension permissions include tabs, panes, projects, worktrees, agents:read/write, files and git read/write.

sources.title: Privacy policy (phone app)
sources.locator: Summary; Notifications; What the app does not collect
sources.finding: No account, no analytics, advertising or third-party SDKs; only paired computers or SSH hosts are contacted; notifications go through an encrypted relay at muxy.app; no usage or crash analytics.

sources.title: Settings
sources.finding: Desktop settings including appearance, composer, servers and keyboard.

sources.title: Troubleshooting
sources.finding: Common problems and fixes.

sources.title: Workspace crates
sources.finding: Rust workspace crates: muxy-app, muxy-app-core, muxy-cli, muxy-client, muxy-core, muxy-mobile, muxy-protocol, muxy-server, muxy-terminal and muxy-ui.

sources.title: Workspace manifest
sources.finding: Cargo workspace for the Rust application, CLI, server and mobile client library.
